body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Haier introduced its new line of digital camcorders at CES 2010 in Las Vegas.

Haier's new HD digital camcorders offer features that make it simple for consumers to record important events and savor precious memories. From thin flip screen camcorders to 1080p HD, Haier's line offers flexibility for different needs.

"With touch screen controls, video stabilization and 1080p HD quality video, Haier is providing the benefits of more expensive cameras at a competitive price giving consumers the options that they desire in this competitive marketplace," said Stewart Katz, Vice President of Portable Media Electronics for Haier America.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
